name: Vasectomies
overview: Scripture emphasizes the divine mandate for humanity to be fruitful and multiply, as seen in God's blessings to Adam and Noah to replenish the earth (Genesis 1:28; 9:1,7). The command to raise up offspring within family lines is further underscored in Judah's instruction to Onan to marry and produce seed for his brother (Genesis 38:8). Additionally, Levitical law highlights the importance of wholeness and integrity, forbidding offerings that are bruised or broken (Leviticus 21:17; 22:24), which may symbolically relate to maintaining the physical and spiritual completeness intended by God.
